investigations.name: paper-figures
investigations.title: Process Bigraph paper — figures
investigations.description: One study per figure of the Process Bigraph paper. Each study describes the figure and checks that its bigraph-loom image is generated (shown under Visualizations as an SVG). Fig 2 is conceptual (no composite); Figs 7.1–7.3 and Fig 8 are the runnable spatio-flux composites; some paper figures (e.g. Figs 5–6) live elsewhere and are not built here.

investigations.name: spatio-flux-test-suite
investigations.title: Spatio-Flux Test Suite — compositional multiscale scenarios
investigations.description: The spatio-flux reference application as one investigation, in two layers: (1) 19 reproduction studies that faithfully re-run every scenario of the original test suite as a hardened, quantitatively code-evaluated baseline; and (2) biology-forward studies that extend those composites into new emergent biology — a spatial cross-feeding partnership and a settling biofilm — plus a zero-carbon adversarial control.
